description: Comunidad Foral de Navarra: flood hazard datasets is a collection of datasets listed in datos.gob.es, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Comunidad Foral de Navarra. Coverage: Comunidad Foral de Navarra. The listing groups 11 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about flood hazard; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Ind 189: Metros de infraestructuras en zona inundable. Ayuntamiento de; Zonas inundables. Periodos de retorno del SNCZI; Zonas inundables. Zonas de flujo preferente, otros estudios del Gobier; Zonas inundables. Zonas de flujo preferente del SNCZI. Formats seen: SHP. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-datos-gob-es.
